headline: Kiwi fruit imports under new trade pact prompt local farmers to begin aggressive 'Masala-fication' of seasonal produce
body: Orchard owners in Himachal Pradesh are preemptively coating every imported kiwi in secret dry-rub spices to ensure the fruit remains 'culturally relevant' ahead of the October 20th tariff deadline. Market analysts predict that unless the foreign berries demonstrate a firm grasp of local chutney recipes, they may struggle to find space on the average suburban breakfast table.
caption: Would you buy a kiwi if it came with a packet of chaat masala? Local farmers are clearly not taking any chances with the new trade deal. #TradePact #KiwiMasala #AgriNews #MarketTrends (satire)
igHook: Would you try a chili-dusted kiwi if it meant supporting local farmers?
imagePrompt: A close-up photograph of a wooden market stall showcasing a variety of tropical fruits, with several fuzzy brown kiwis sitting next to small colorful bowls of red spice powder.
